latestVersion.changelog:
Media Content Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generates videos from your uploaded images, video clips, and audio files via cloud GPU processing with no editing software required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, and other formats up to 500MB per upload.
- Anonymous access automatically available for new users; provides 100 free credits and seamless token/session management.
- Handles file upload, asset combination, credits check, export, and project state through clear chat commands.
- Designed for marketers and content creators who need fast, ready-to-publish videos with options like text overlays and audio tracks.
- Responsive error handling with user guidance for unsupported files, authorization, credits, and export issues.
